links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading ease of chatbot answers about isotretinoin
links.effect: No significant difference between programs in Flesch Kincaid reading ease scores (p = 0.671); all three programs were at a difficult level of reading.
links.quote: No significant difference was found between the groups in terms of Flesch Kincaid reading ease scores (p = 0.671), and all three programs were found to be at a difficult level of reading.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini) on accuracy, readability, and understandability when answering patient FAQs about isotretinoin without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
